goal: when the user says something heavy, the agent does not sit silent for seconds before it starts to answer
evidence: pre-generation 6.1 s -> 1.4 s on the replayed turn; idle wait 4,200 ms -> 0 ms

goal: the speaker tag on a stored memory matches who actually said it
measure: tags compared with the raw records

goal: the agent recalls events from outside the current conversation window
measure: exam: is the right memory in the top 3
evidence: 1 of 4 questions; the mechanism ran (out-of-window memories were fetched) but the answer did not reach the top 3

goal: duplicate alarms stop flooding the log
measure: alarm rows per hour per fingerprint

goal: texts longer than the accelerator's fixed length fall back to CPU instead of being cut
measure: fallback counter on the health endpoint

goal: the router falls back to rules when the classifier fails
